name: race 取最快分支、parallel 全部完成（含败者取消留痕）
script:
__DONE = false
on_start(function()
  task.spawn(function()
    local w = race({ function() time.sleep(10) return "fast" end, function() time.sleep(50) return "slow" end })
    log.info("race=%s", w)
    local rs = parallel({ function() time.sleep(10) return 1 end, function() time.sleep(10) return 2 end })
    log.info("par=%d,%d", rs[1], rs[2])
    __DONE = true
  end)
end)
